candidates.name: FSCTL_GET_RETRIEVAL_POINTER_BASE
verified_facts: Returns the sector offset from volume start to the file-system logical-cluster base.
semantic_limits: The base is meaningful only with the same volume, geometry, and retrieval-pointer snapshot.

candidates.name: IOCTL_STORAGE_QUERY_PROPERTY
verified_facts: Queries supported device or adapter property descriptors through DeviceIoControl.
semantic_limits: A successful property query does not authenticate the hardware or prove descriptor persistence.

candidates.name: STORAGE_PROPERTY_QUERY
verified_facts: Specifies the storage property identifier, query type, and optional parameters.
semantic_limits: Query buffers require exact initialization, supported-property checks, and bounded output parsing.

candidates.name: STORAGE_PROPERTY_ID
verified_facts: Enumerates storage device, adapter, alignment, trim, seek, protocol, and temperature properties.
semantic_limits: Property support varies by device, driver, transport, and Windows release.

candidates.name: STORAGE_DESCRIPTOR_HEADER
verified_facts: Provides descriptor version and total size for two-stage storage-property buffer allocation.
semantic_limits: Header size must be bounded before allocation; reported size alone does not validate descriptor content.

candidates.name: STORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR
verified_facts: Returns device type, bus, removable state, command queuing, and string offsets.
semantic_limits: Vendor, product, revision, and serial offsets can be absent or driver-supplied and are not sole identity proof.

candidates.name: STORAGE_ADAPTER_DESCRIPTOR
verified_facts: Returns adapter transfer limits, alignment, bus type, command-queue, and protocol capabilities.
semantic_limits: Adapter capabilities are not device identity and can change with driver or path configuration.

candidates.name: STORAGE_ACCESS_ALIGNMENT_DESCRIPTOR
verified_facts: Returns logical and physical sector alignment and cache-line offset information.
semantic_limits: Alignment geometry must be correlated with the exact device and does not prove content integrity.

candidates.name: DEVICE_SEEK_PENALTY_DESCRIPTOR
verified_facts: Reports whether a storage device incurs a seek penalty.
semantic_limits: The boolean is a performance characteristic, not a reliable HDD/SSD identity or health verdict.

candidates.name: DEVICE_TRIM_DESCRIPTOR
verified_facts: Reports whether a device supports trim or unmap semantics.
semantic_limits: Trim support does not prove that trim occurred or that deallocated data is unrecoverable.

candidates.name: STORAGE_TEMPERATURE_DATA_DESCRIPTOR
verified_facts: Returns one or more current storage temperature records and descriptor metadata.
semantic_limits: Temperature telemetry may be unsupported, stale, rounded, or vendor-defined and is diagnostic only.

candidates.name: STORAGE_TEMPERATURE_INFO
verified_facts: Carries a sensor index, current temperature, thresholds, and status fields.
semantic_limits: Sensor readings require unit, index, threshold, timestamp, and device correlation.

candidates.name: STORAGE_PROTOCOL_DATA_DESCRIPTOR
verified_facts: Returns protocol-specific storage data and embeds a validated protocol-data request result.
semantic_limits: Protocol data is transport-specific and requires strict offset, length, version, and device checks.

candidates.name: IOCTL_STORAGE_GET_DEVICE_NUMBER
verified_facts: Returns device type, device number, and partition number for an open storage handle.
semantic_limits: Device numbers are guaranteed only until device removal or system restart and are not persistent IDs.

candidates.name: STORAGE_DEVICE_NUMBER
verified_facts: Carries the device type, device number, and partition number from the storage-number query.
semantic_limits: The tuple must be joined to boot identity, volume extents, handle, and observation time.
